SELECT SUM(C.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth C 
WHERE C.CustomerID = 6 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM C.Date) BETWEEN 8 AND 11 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM C.Date) = 2013
SELECT SUM(c.Consumption) FROM yearmonth c WHERE c.CustomerID = 6 AND c.Date >= '2013-08-01' AND c.Date <= '2013-11-30'

SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T1.CustomerID = 6 AND MONTH(T1.Date) BETWEEN 8 AND 11 AND YEAR(T1.Date) = 2013

SELECT SUM(T2.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth AS T2 
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T1 
ON T2.CustomerID = T1.CustomerID 
WHERE T2.CustomerID = 6 AND T2.Date BETWEEN '2013-08-01' AND '2013-11-30'

SELECT SUM(C.Consumption) 
FROM yearmonth C 
WHERE C.Date BETWEEN '2013-08-01' AND '2013-11-30' AND C.CustomerID = 6
